name: cutaway
description: Learn how engines, wings, and machines work with interactive cutaways. Built for ChatGPT using Ryan's /anatomy toolkit.

interface.longDescription:
Look inside a GE9X jet engine, follow water through an espresso machine, compare wing designs, or watch the pistons in a boxer engine. Select parts, move the controls, and download the view as HTML or SVG. Each model includes explanations, sources, and its simplifications.

The hosted tools open these models inside ChatGPT. The bundled drawing skill can create other machines using your session’s file and code tools. You don’t need a separate API key or Cutaway account.

The drawing toolkit comes from Ryan’s (@wheresryan22) MIT-licensed /anatomy. Optional glow and palettes come from April Zhu’s iso-glow, based on Tolga Cohce’s iso-figure. Cutaway adapts their work for ChatGPT and keeps the upstream licenses.
defaultPrompt: Show the GE9X compressor and explain how its turbine drives it.
Open the wing cutaway with the flaps at 25 degrees and the slat extended.
Open the espresso machine while brewing and highlight the pump.
